name: OpenNIH_search_grants
description: Search NIH project-year rows. WARNING: total_funding is a row sum, and repeated full project numbers can double-count parent/component dollars. Covers FY1985-present and filters by topic, project number, PI, institution, Institute/Center, activity code, or fiscal-year window. Returns matching rows, distinct-award counts, recorded funding totals, IDs, and provenance. Results are paged by at most 50 rows with offset capped at 100000, so a slice above 100050 rows cannot be fully retrieved: narrow the year or filters before custom aggregation. total_funding is null, not zero, when no matching row reports an award amount.

query.description: Natural-language topic or combined search string.

text_search.description: Text to match in grant fields.

fiscal_year_end.description: Last NIH fiscal year of the window (inclusive, 1985-2100); must not be below fiscal_year_start.

activity_code.description: NIH activity code such as R01 or K23.

ic.description: NIH Institute/Center abbreviation, code, or name. Prefer an exact abbreviation; a name fragment can select multiple or unexpected historical labels, so inspect returned ic_scope. institution.description: Case-insensitive substring over raw organization names. This can match multiple canonical institutions or campuses (for example, Harvard); inspect org_name values and use rank_institutions to resolve one entity_id before institution-level analysis.

pi_name.description: Principal investigator name to filter by (2-64 characters).

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return (1-50, default 20).

offset.description: Zero-based row offset, capped at 100000. With limit=50 the largest fully retrievable matching slice is 100050 rows.

mechanisms_excluded.description: What was left out, e.g. 'intramural (Z01/ZIA), contracts (N01), ...'. NIH intramural research is a large programme and is not in an 'rpg_research' figure.

ranking_scope.description: What the ranking ranked over, e.g. 'competitive RPG-research only (R01 baseline)'.

funding_trend_scope.description: Which mechanisms the funding trend covers; it can be narrower than the rest of the reply.

top_pis_scope.description: Which mechanisms the top-PI list covers.

mechanism_mix_scope.description: Which mechanisms the mix covers, e.g. 'whole NIH portfolio (all mechanism classes)'. Often WIDER than funding_trend_scope in the same reply, so the two cannot be divided into each other.

entity_resolution_note.description: How institutions were resolved, e.g. 'institutions resolved via DUNS + normalised name'. Determines whether two campuses count as one body.

entity_scope_note.description: What one entity means here, e.g. that a profile aggregates a single resolved entity, or that campuses aggregate together.

ic_display_note.description: How the Institute/Center name is rendered.

ic_match_mode.description: How an IC filter was matched, where one was given.

institution_filter_note.description: How the institution parameter was matched, e.g. case-insensitive substring. A loose match can pull in a neighbouring institution.

match_strategy_note.description: How a topic was matched -- against the OFFICIAL NIH RCDC categories, or by text. The two select different grant sets.

match_strategy_reason.description: Why that strategy was chosen, when it was chosen automatically.

rcdc_note.description: What the RCDC categories are and from when they are present.

rcdc_coverage.description: How much of the corpus carries official RCDC category tags at all.

first_tagged_fiscal_year.description: Earliest year with any tags, e.g. 1985.

service_surface_first_fiscal_year.description: Earliest year NIH's own service exposes them, e.g. 2008. Between this and first_tagged_fiscal_year the tags exist locally but not upstream.

tagged_pct.description: The percentage tagged, e.g. 38.65. The other 61% cannot be found by category however the topic is phrased.

rcdc_window_coverage.description: How much of the REQUESTED window carries tags.

coverage.description: The fraction, e.g. 0.677. Below 1 the topic search missed part of the window by construction.

minimum_required.description: The threshold below which the tool falls back to a text match, e.g. 0.5.

tagged_rows.description: How many of them are tagged.

pi_identity_note.description: How a person was identified. Measured: 'exact pi_profile_id is primary; rows with the same case-normalised name...' -- so two investigators sharing a name may be merged, and one person with two ids may be split.

subproject_rule.description: How multi-component awards are counted. Measured: 'subproject_component=true marks a component row of a multi-project award', which is why summing components and parents double-counts.

null_fiscal_year_rule.description: How a row with no fiscal year is reported -- as null rather than dropped, so it is in the totals but in no year of a trend.

fiscal_year_window.description: The window the figures cover, e.g. 'FY2024-FY2025'.

ic.description: The Institute or Center queried, e.g. 'NCI'.

ic_scope.description: How the IC name was resolved.

matched_ic_names.description: The ICs the query actually matched.

n_total.description: How many exist in the corpus. n against n_total says how much of NIH the figure covers.

match_strategy.description: How the topic was matched, e.g. 'rcdc' against the official NIH categories. A text match and an RCDC match select different grant sets.

requested_match_strategy.description: What was asked for, e.g. 'auto'. Differs from match_strategy when the tool chose.

matched_rcdc_categories.description: The official RCDC categories the topic resolved to, e.g. ['Immunotherapy'].

alternate_surface_grants.description: What the other matching strategy would have found, where computed. The size of the disagreement between strategies.
